models.name: Request
models.description: Pipeline parameters — question type plus how many styled variants to write.

fields.name: question_type
fields.description: Topic / year level / question style to generate

fields.name: variations
fields.description: How many differently styled questions to generate

models.name: StyleJob
models.description: One batch item — write a full question in a named presentation style.

models.name: StyledQuestion
models.description: One complete LaTeX question body written for a style.

fields.name: latex_body
fields.description: LaTeX question BODY (not a full document); concrete numbers, no {placeholders}

models.name: LatexPack
models.description: Final LaTeX worksheet joining styled batch questions.

modules.label: Request
modules.inputDescription: JSON with question_type (string) and variations (positive integer count)

modules.label: Expand → Style Jobs
modules.note: Request → list[StyleJob] — one job per variation with a rotating presentation style.
modules.code: (req) => { const styles = ["exam-style with clean stem", "worded real-world story problem", "scaffolded multi-part (a)(b)", "diagram-first TikZ then short ask", "challenge extension with a twist"]; const n = Math.max(1, Math.min(12, Number(req?.variations) || 3)); const qtype = String(req?.question_type ?? ""); return Array.from({ length: n }, (_, i) => ({ example_id: `ex-${i + 1}`, question_type: qtype, style: styles[i % styles.length] })); }

modules.label: Write Styled Questions
modules.note: list[StyleJob] → list[StyledQuestion]. One full LaTeX body per style.
modules.inputDescription: List of StyleJob objects — question_type plus style hint
modules.prompt:
Write ONE complete tutoring question for the given question_type, in the given style.
Keep the same example_id and style.
Return latex_body as a LaTeX question BODY only (not a full document): concrete numbers/labels (no {placeholders}), clear exam wording, and a TikZ diagram only when the style or topic needs one.
Make this variant feel different from other styles — change framing, numbers, and difficulty slightly while staying on-topic.

modules.label: Join LaTeX Worksheet
modules.inputDescription: List of StyledQuestion objects with latex_body

modules.label: LaTeX Worksheet
modules.inputDescription: Single LatexPack — title plus complete LaTeX document text
